Left: what the review found in the source. Right: the proposed pane, Fields and SQL as two views of one Step. Bottom: the one recipe every popup and nested control follows.
Interactive prototype was not requested, so these are static mockups.

Interchangeability rule: switching views never changes the stored SQL. Editing in either view rewrites both. What the field list cannot express stays a Custom SQL row; a WHERE or JOIN keeps the Fields tab disabled with a reason.
